zh: n 最多 2000，选的人数也不超过 n，所以每一轮直接在候选人里找最大值、再把他删掉，总共 O(n·team_size) 就够了，不需要更巧妙的数据结构。
每轮的候选人是剩余序列的前 k 个和后 k 个的并集；两段重叠时同一个人只算一次。剩余序列始终保持原顺序，所以“原下标最小”就等于“在当前序列中位置最靠前”。
重复 team_size 轮：在位置 [0, k) 和 [len−k, len) 中找分数最高者，同分取位置最小的，把分数加进总和并从序列中删除。分数可为负，总和用 64 位整数。
en: n is at most 2000 and at most n people are picked, so finding the maximum among the candidates and deleting that person each round costs O(n * team_size) in total; no clever data structure is needed.

Each round's candidates are the union of the first k and the last k people of the remaining sequence; when the two windows overlap, a person counts only once. The remaining sequence keeps its original order, so the smallest original index is simply the earliest position in the current sequence.

Repeat team_size times: among positions [0, k) and [len-k, len), pick the highest score, breaking ties by the smaller position; add the score to the total and remove that person. Scores can be negative, so use a 64-bit total.

explanationEn:
## Approach

In each round, build the union of the two candidate windows, choose by score descending and then by original index ascending, and then delete that employee from the sequence.

## Correctness

The candidate set equals the union of the two windows in the statement; the sort key implements "highest score first, earliest index on ties". Deleting one person per round keeps the remaining sequence in order, which matches the definition.

## Complexity

O(n * team_size) time; this site has n<=2000, and O(n) space.
